items.title: Caterpillar (CAT) Completes Ultra Low Methane Field Trial For Remote Gas Compression
items.summary: Caterpillar (NYSE:CAT) reported a successful field trial of a large horsepower gas compression system with ultra low methane emissions. The trial, conducted with Phoenix Service Partners, targeted remote natural gas compression operations without relying on grid connectivity. Field results indicated materially lower methane and other harmful emissions compared with conventional gas compression setups used in similar locations.
